<thought>Search the template catalog for a retrosynthetic template that forms a C‑C double bond and a carboxylic ester (the product of a Still‑Gennari HWE reaction). Use a representative product such as methyl acrylate (SMILES C=CC(=O)OC) and specify the formed functional groups as “C-C double bonds” and “carboxylic esters”. Limit to a few results.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "C=CC(=O)OC",
    "functional_groups_formed": ["C-C double bonds", "carboxylic esters"],
    "limit": 5
}</action_input>
